claims.text: Pain Tx by severity and pain type: topical lidocaine, systemic NSAIDs, acetaminophen, gabapentin or pregabalin, SNRIs
claims.quote: Treatments may include topical agents like lidocaine, systemic nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, acetaminophen, atypical anticonvulsants such as gabapentin or pregabalin, and serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, depending on disease severity and pain type.

claims.quote: Duloxetine may be particularly beneficial for patients with comorbid depression.
